entities.summary: Mark Patrick Sweeney is an American sports commentator and former professional baseball outfielder and first baseman who is a telecast analyst for the St. Louis Cardinals of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played 14 seasons in MLB for the St. Louis Cardinals, San Diego Padres, Cincinnati Reds, Milwaukee Brewers, Colorado Rockies, San Francisco Giants, and Los Angeles Dodgers. He is best known for his skill as a pinch hitter, where he ranks second in career pinch hits with 175 and first in career pinch hit runs batted in with 102.
